wikipedia.title: List of tallest buildings in Toronto

records.Skyline of Toronto.1: Downtown Toronto Humber Bay Yonge–Eglinton North York City Centre

records.Name: CN Tower
records.Notes: Not a habitable building. Included for comparison purposes. Tallest free-standing structure in the world from 1976 to 2007, and tallest tower until 2009.[76]

records.Name: SkyTower at Pinnacle One Yonge
records.Notes: Currently the tallest building in Canada. Topped off in early 2026. First building in Canada over 100 storeys.[77]

records.Name: One Bloor West
records.Notes: Formerly known as The One. Topped off in late 2025. Briefly the tallest building in Canada from 2025 to 2026.[78]

records.Name: First Canadian Place
records.Notes: Tallest building in Canada from 1975 to 2025. 8th-tallest building in the world at the time of its completion. Tallest building in the world outside Chicago and New York City at the time of its completion. Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 1970s. Formerly known as First Bank Tower.[79]

records.Name: The St. Regis Toronto
records.Notes: Tallest mixed-use building in Canada. Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 2010s. Formerly known as Trump International Hotel & Tower Toronto and later as The Adelaide Hotel.[80]

records.Name: Scotia Plaza
records.Notes: Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 1980s.[81]

records.Name: Aura
records.Notes: Tallest residential building in Toronto and in Canada.[82]

records.Name: TD Canada Trust Tower
records.Notes: Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 1990s.[83]

records.Name: CIBC Square I
records.Notes: Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 2020s so far.[86]

records.Name: Commerce Court West
records.Notes: Tallest building in Toronto from 1972 to 1975.[87]

records.Name: Sugar Wharf Tower G
records.Notes: Also known as Sugar Wharf Tower II.[92]

records.Name: Eau du Soleil Sky Tower
records.Notes: Canada's tallest building outside a central business district.[93]

records.Name: TD Bank Tower
records.Notes: Tallest building in Toronto from 1967 to 1972. Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 1960s. Also known simply as TD Tower.[96]

records.Name: Bay Adelaide Centre West
records.Notes: Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 2000s.[100]
